description: 한국지역난방공사_산업재해 및 안전사고 사망자수 현황 [district heating and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국지역난방공사. 한국지역난방공사의 산업재해 및 안전사고 사망자수 현황 데이터를 정리한 자료로, 연도별 재해유형과 발생구분(직영·협력사 등)에 따른 사망자 수를 통해 산업안전 수준과 재해 예방 성과를. The portal shows 2026-08-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
